title: Bitcoin Price Trades Down Near $73,500 After Hot CPI Print Lifts Fed Hike Bets
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Trades Down Near $73,500 After Hot CPI Print Lifts Fed Hike Bets Bitcoin price slipped to $73,500 Tuesday morning after October consumer prices rose 0.4%, topping forecasts and pushing traders toward a bigger Federal Reserve rate hike in December. This post Bitcoin Price Trades Down Near $73,500 After Hot CPI Print Lifts Fed Hike Bets first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
